in_marathi.name: Ayanin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayanin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayana', which means 'direction' or 'goal'. The suffix '-in' denotes 'Lord of'. Thus, Ayanin can be translated as 'Lord of the Vedas'. The Vedas are the oldest and most sacred texts of Hinduism, and are considered the foundation of Hindu philosophy.
